scope: Dedicated original Goo stun and cooldown, native fall boots, two-player hook ownership, remote HUD replay, and native Beta food hunger/original-healing modes through the existing connector settings.
generic_changes: Dedicated original game hooks use native ServerTick.Pre with per-player clocks, retention and authenticated server actor/world/equipment; bounded client presentation is independent of HUD rendering
Hook-reachable mutable primitive/String fields on each original BaseMod implementation hierarchy have scoped per-UUID values; helper-class collections and wall clocks remain original shared code
Native player/block/menu callbacks restore the owning actor or neutral scalar state through nested calls and exceptions; logout/server stop clear scoped state
Movement-speed intent remembers a released baseline so repeated original cooldown writes cannot reinstall an override over foreign native modifiers
Remote hook HUD recording retains original alpha/depth/matrix state and one common GUI canvas; oversized or unbalanced drawing frames are discarded without aborting gameplay
Hosted Beta FoodItem and StackableFoodItem have native nutrition (original healing clamped0..20), saturation modifier0.6 and32-tick eating; original callbacks still own held counts and remainders
Only positive healing of the consuming actor inside the original FoodItem callback is suppressed in hunger mode; native eating supplies food/saturation/statistics without double consumption

Food mode uses existing config/legacyconnector.properties and existing config screen, key b173.foodUsesHunger defaulttrue; a separate bounded handshake synchronizes the dedicated server value independently of game hooks

verified_failures: Original six-second stun never restores native speed or expires cooldown
causal_baseline.fall_baseline_not_claimed: The old fall observer could accept a stale onGround flag immediately after teleport; final checks require observed airborne movement, an actual12-block drop and landing atY69.

boundaries: Actual tests use unchanged isolated PlasticCraft2.1.3 and disposable native worlds; arbitrary legacy mod/version combinations are not implied
Two native ServerPlayer actors are exercised; one is the connected graphical client, the secondary has a packet-sink connection and no second real socket
Actual game hooks run original wall-clock Stun code; fixtures read timers/lists but never call its tick directly or shorten its6+4-second timers
Scalar isolation covers hook-reachable writes in the original BaseMod hierarchy; helper object graphs are deliberately shared
The gameplay protocols are optional and bounded; existing single-player dispatch and modern-only gameplay are preserved
Mod versions, original resources and original PlasticCraft options were not changed; no private archives, credentials or generated test worlds are committed
